BrochureContent.Content:
HWP Estate Agents are delighted to present; 6 Belard Manor, Glenealy, Wicklow to the residential property market. 

Nestled within the highly regarded Belard Manor development, No. 6 is an exceptional detached five-bedroom family residence extending to approximately 185 sq.m. (1,991 sq.ft.) of bright and generously proportioned living accommodation. Presented in excellent condition throughout, this impressive home combines spacious family living with modern comforts in one of Wicklow Town's most sought-after residential locations.

Upon entering, a welcoming entrance hall leads to a series of well-appointed reception and living spaces designed to accommodate the needs of modern family life. The property offers an abundance of natural light throughout, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere in every room.

Upstairs, Five spacious bedrooms provide excellent accommodation for growing families. The principal bedroom benefits from a private ensuite bathroom, while the remaining bedrooms are all generously sized and well presented. The family bathroom is a standout feature of the home, finished with luxurious tiling throughout and complete with an impressive corner Jacuzzi bath, creating the perfect space to relax and unwind.

To the rear, the property enjoys a large, private garden offering an ideal setting for outdoor entertaining, family gatherings, or simply enjoying the peace and tranquillity of this mature residential neighbourhood. The generous outdoor space provides ample room for children to play and offers excellent potential for further landscaping or garden enhancements.

Belard Manor is a well-established and highly desirable development situated within easy reach of Wicklow Town Centre and its excellent range of amenities including schools, supermarkets, cafes, restaurants, sporting facilities and public transport links. The N11/M11 road network is easily accessible, making Dublin and surrounding areas convenient for commuters. 
Also visible from the property is Carrick Mountain, providing breathtaking views & creating a truly special setting for this home. Whether enjoying your morning coffee overlooking the hills or relaxing in the evening as the sun sets behind Carrick Mountain, the scenery is simply unforgettable & there is easy access to a variety to walking/hiking trails.

With its spacious accommodation, impressive BER rating, private gardens and superb location, No. 6 Belard Manor represents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a quality detached family home in the heart of Wicklow Town.
